title: potentilla argentea subvar. latisecta
intro: Potentilla argentea subvar. latisecta, commonly known as Silver Buffaloberry, is a shrub native to North America, characterized by its silvery-gray leaves and clusters of white or pink flowers. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla argentea subvar. latisecta include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids. The bioactive constituents of this plant may also contribute to its potential health benefits, including cardiovascular protection and antiviral activity.
